about: Face Dance as Meringue does it: a tight, locked close-up where the face keeps a short pop beat with its brows, cheeks, eyes and mouth. The motion is a face-dance video's (DWPose's face landmarks, face-dance.pose, squeezed to a kitten's short muzzle so the mouth lands on hers: the lower face at 0.43 of a person's), placed on the 9:16 frame; the take is two chained takes, the second starting on the first's frame 96. {Lead} is that role's name and look. No style is needed beyond the sheet's.

sound.note: The trend's own sound, under the cut. It is a licensed song, so it is replaced or removed before the repository is published.

roles.look: a snowy-white longhaired kitten with big sky-blue eyes, a tiny pink nose, fluffy white fur and a coral-pink ribbon at her neck

beats.text: Her face keeps the beat: a brow, the cheeks, the eyes, the mouth

shots.prompt: Tight vertical close-up of {Lead}'s face and chest against a plain soft lilac-grey wall in soft even light, the camera locked. {Lead} stays silent and does a rhythmic face dance in time with a short pop beat: one brow lifts on an accent, then the cheeks puff, the eyes widen, the mouth rounds and the brows reset, each on its own beat, the head tilting a little with the rhythm, all of it with an exact, playful expressiveness. Polished 3D animated feature-film style, a soft shallow depth of field.
